name: Bromantane
summary: An unusual stimulant and anxiolytic drug with dopamine and serotonin reuptake inhibition properties. Infamously used as a doping agent in the 1996 Olympics. There are some concerns it may exacerbate the underlying causes of Alzheimer's disease.
doseBasis: NOTE: Anticholinergic effects at high doses (around 500mg)

pharmacology.text: Although the effects of bromantane have been determined to be dependent on the dopaminergic and possibly serotonergic neurotransmitter systems, its exact mechanism of action is unknown, and is distinct in its properties relative to typical stimulants such as amphetamine.

uses.text: Bromantane, sold under the brand name Ladasten, is an atypical central nervous system (CNS) stimulant and anxiolytic drug of the adamantane family that is related to amantadine and memantine. Medically, it is approved in Russia for the treatment of neurasthenia.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include dry mouth, sleeplessness and headache. It has been little studied outside Russia, so its longer-term effects are not well known.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括口乾、失眠與頭痛。它在俄羅斯以外幾乎沒有被研究，因此較長期的影響並不清楚。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括口干、失眠与头痛。它在俄罗斯以外几乎没有被研究，因此较长期的影响并不清楚。

fact.en: It is built on adamantane, the diamond shaped carbon cage, like amantadine and memantine. Several athletes tested positive for it at the 1996 Olympics, which is how most people first heard of it.
fact.zh: 布羅曼丹建立在金剛烷這個鑽石形碳籠結構上，與金剛烷胺和美金剛相同。1996 年奧運有多名運動員的檢測結果呈陽性，大多數人也因此才知道它。
fact.zhHans: 布罗曼丹创建在金刚烷这个钻石形碳笼结构上，与金刚烷胺和美金刚相同。1996 年奥运有多名运动员的检测结果呈阳性，大多数人也因此才知道它。
